requirement_match.summary: Approved taxonomy fields implemented; selection/create-only and Enter/delete/limits locally verified.

security.summary: Same-origin and staff authentication preserved; server requires admin for creation, bounded names and reads, no secret or production actions.

code_quality.summary: Scoped ESLint, TypeScript and build pass; existing update/autosave patterns preserved; no dependency additions.

failure_paths.summary: Historical pre-fix review cycle 1; current final corrections are recorded in cycle 3.

error_handling.summary: Existing request-ID error envelope and dismissible toast preserved; failed creation does not replace confirmed category.

production_readiness.summary: Deployment and rollback constraints reviewed. No migrations. Actual production status remains NOT_READY; full authenticated editor E2E and live checks absent.

trade_offs.summary: Snapshot suggestions and bounded 100-entry catalog; legacy edit flow can independently duplicate names; dirty WIP and declared-only self-review limitations disclosed.

findings.summary: Composition-end Enter can have isComposing false; premature tag/category commit must be prevented.
Repeated identical limit notices did not restart the existing toast timer.

residual_risks: Existing category-edit flow can independently produce duplicate names; suggestions snapshot loaded catalog.
limitations: UI browser fixture uses stubbed API, not full authenticated editor E2E.
Legacy review is declared self-review, not authenticated independent production certification.
Shared dirty worktree and concurrent unrelated edits retained; production readiness NOT_READY.
